description: Verified loyalty-program coverage of this application's award providers. Status vocabulary: OBSERVED_LIVE = this installation received real fares from the program; DOCUMENTED_ONLY = the vendor documents support but we have not seen it on our routes; DEGRADED = works but thin/unreliable in observation; UNAVAILABLE = requested and empirically absent. Never inferred from alliance membership.
notes: 'integrated' means THIS application's provider wrapper can return the program today. Roame is searched with mileagePrograms:[ALL]; the programs it actually returns are route-dependent.

The ATF integration calls fixed per-airline endpoints (british_airways, qatar_airways, cathay_pacific, virgin_atlantic, iberia). It IS configured here since 2026-08-27 via an autonomous-agent REST key. The free tier is economy-only (the API reports cabin_access: 'economy_only') with a 50-call monthly allowance, so ATF cannot answer any business or first question on this account, and the airline subset is configurable via ATF_AIRLINES (default 'iberia') because each airline is a separate call.
Absence on a route is NOT proof a program is unsupported: award inventory is route- and date-specific. Only MILES_AND_MORE was probed directly by program key and found empty.

Lufthansa-group FIRST partner awards ended ~2026-06-01 (secondary reporting), and our probes confirm zero LH-group First through partner programs. A Miles & More source is REQUIRED for Austrian/Lufthansa/Swiss First.

ATF does not appear to charge for a 'no availability' answer: after 8 empty Iberia probes the provider still reported 50/50 remaining, and only a call that returned data decremented it. Our local accounting still counts every attempt, which is the conservative direction.

ATF Iberia returned NO availability on 10 consecutive probes (MAD-MEX x3, MAD-CUN x3, MAD-LHR x2, MAD-JFK, plus one earlier MAD-LHR), including short-haul MAD-LHR where Avios space is normally plentiful, and MAD-JFK on the very date BA LHR-JFK returned 6 economy seats. Iberia calls also take ~13s against BA's ~0.7s. That pattern points at ATF's Iberia SOURCE, not at Iberia's inventory.

MILES_AND_MORE.otherCandidates: seats.aero (source 'lufthansa', Y/J/F, live+cached, Partner API with Pro $9.99/mo, 1000 calls/day non-commercial); PointsYeah (live, commercial API by partnership); AwardTool ($10.99/mo). No official Lufthansa award API; direct scraping needs member login + 7,000-mile minimum balance.
MILES_AND_MORE.observedLive: 2026-08-27 CASE B: Roame ACCEPTS the program key 'LUFTHANSA' (a targeted search created a job successfully) but returned ZERO Miles & More fares across four probes on two routes, including one that reached 100% completion. Vendor documentation (roame.travel/programs + their 'Roame now searches Lufthansa Miles & More' guide) is therefore NOT reflected in what this free-tier account receives. Cause not determined from outside: plausibly PRO-tier gating or an unshipped/broken integration. Consequence: no Miles & More pricing, and no LH-group First visibility at all.

IBERIA.observedLive: 2026-08-27, 10 probes, ZERO availability: MAD-MEX (2026-11-12, 2027-02-03, 2026-11-18, 2027-03-10 not reached), MAD-CUN (2027-02-04, 2027-01-20), MAD-LHR (2026-10-21, 2026-11-18), MAD-JFK (2026-11-18). Each answered HTTP 400 'No availability found'. Two things make 'Iberia simply has no seats' the weaker explanation: MAD-LHR short-haul essentially always carries Avios economy space, and MAD-JFK was empty on the SAME DATE that BA LHR-JFK returned 6 seats through the same API and key. Iberia calls also consistently take ~13 seconds versus ~0.7s for BA, which looks like an upstream search timing out and being reported as an empty result. Treated as DEGRADED - the integration works, the data does not. Not retried on a schedule.

liveValidation.roameEnumFinding: Roame's program identifier for Miles & More is 'LUFTHANSA', NOT 'MILES_AND_MORE' (the latter is rejected: 'MILES_AND_MORE is not a valid MileageProgram'). 'LUFTHANSA' is ACCEPTED by initiateFlightSearch, but returned ZERO Miles & More fares in every probe, including a run that reached 100% completion.
liveValidation.completionCaveat: Roame searches ended at 91%, 95% and 100% completion across probes — the poller returns early when no new fares arrive for ~12s. The 100% run still contained no Miles & More, so the absence is not a completion artefact.
liveValidation.austrianFinding: Austrian-operated (OS) award inventory IS discoverable, exclusively via AEROPLAN in these probes: 34 OS fares VIE→BKK (cheapest 92,500 pts + $90, VIE→ARN→BKK, 3 seats) and 17 OS fares VIE→CUN (cheapest 81,300 pts + $180 via MUC/YYZ). No other program returned OS metal.
liveValidation.firstClassFinding: First-class award space appeared only under AMERICAN (10 fares, cheapest 90,000 pts + $145 on BA/WY metal via LHR/MCT). ZERO Lufthansa-group First was visible through any partner program — consistent with LH-group ending partner First awards around 2026-06. LH/OS/LX First therefore requires a Miles & More-capable source we do not currently have.
